plugin.name: Pixel sprites
plugin.description: Search 1.4 million AI-generated 16×16 pixel art sprites from the Library.
plugin.longDescription: Adds a Pixel sprites tab to the Library: 1.4 million 16×16 sprites with transparent backgrounds, such as weapons, potions, food, monsters and furniture, searched by meaning ("red dragon" finds red dragons). The sprites are AI-generated (Krea 2 Turbo with a pixel art LoRA) and released under CC0 by the Pixel Art Atlas dataset to the extent its author can waive rights; Krea's license has its own terms for commercial use. The first search downloads about 12 MB of search data.
source.title: Pixel sprites
source.description: AI-generated 16×16 pixel art from the Pixel Art Atlas dataset, CC0 as far as its author can waive rights; check Krea's license before commercial use. Search in English, or common Chinese game words.
config.scale.title: Size when added
config.scale.description: An added sprite is 16×16, or scaled up 4 or 8 times with each pixel kept sharp.
